tasks.title: Pipette from stand, fit a tip, draw from a bottle, dispense into a tube
tasks.description: tool pickup / insertion / deep and shallow vessels / sequence
tasks.goal: Lift the pipette off its stand, press on a tip, draw from the open bottle, dispense into the open rack tube, eject the tip and hang the pipette back.
tasks.adaptation: Single open-slot stand; pipette held by pad friction (no weld); tip seating is a weld that engages only inside the bore; the destination tube stands open in the rack instead of being held; actuated plunger; no liquid.

tasks.adaptation: Two UR5e arms replace two hands; the dial is the top button on a hinge with light damping (no detents or volume readout); a 270 degree turn stands in for the clip's repeated twists; single-slot stand.

tasks.title: Move a tube from a full rack to another rack
tasks.description: grasping among close neighbours / placing into a fixture
tasks.goal: Lift one capped tube out of the full rack and seat it in an empty well of the second rack.
tasks.adaptation: Low-profile racks; the off-camera destination is a second rack to the right; the other tubes of the full rack are static but collidable; the jaw wears slim fingertip plates and pinches the cap so the stock pads stay above the neighbours; fingertip plates to reach between neighbouring caps.

tasks.title: Unscrew and re-screw a 50 mL tube cap with two arms
tasks.goal: One arm steadies the tube in its rack; the other grips the cap, unscrews it one turn, lifts it off, lowers it and screws it back.
tasks.adaptation: Two UR5e arms replace two hands; the tube stays in a low-profile rack instead of being lifted from a tray; the thread is a one-turn lock (no lead) that disengages when unscrewed and re-engages when the cap is lowered; the wrist turns a full revolution without regrasping.
